headline: Release truth now proves what can act, what exact artifact is staged, and why production cannot yet move.

items.title: Four independently proven authority planes
items.insight: Service-role REST can no longer masquerade as management, SQL, or Function authority. The public-safe receipt reports REST ready and the other three planes dark with exact reason codes.

items.title: Honest-dark identity migration receipt
items.insight: Source hashes, callback contract, Worker/staging state, rollback anchors, roles, and missing provider evidence now live in one privacy-safe artifact. Unverified steps are visible instead of absent or fabricated.

items.title: Promotion consumes the evidence lattice
items.insight: A cosmetically ready state file cannot bypass dark identity, authority, runtime, provider, or review evidence. Every routed-production workflow remains held until all dependencies and explicit confirmation agree.

items.title: Exact-SHA candidate attestation
items.insight: Source-shell similarity is no longer enough to call staging green. Canonical staging publishes its build beacon and candidateReady requires exact deployed/candidate SHA equality.

items.title: Remote compliance false-red removed at the root
items.insight: The consent test stopped clearing the storage state it later asserted. Browser-context isolation remains strict and the product persistence assertion remains intact.
items.evidence: exact compliance 29/29 · two-worker stress 40/40 · remote E2E green

items.title: One release story for humans and agents
items.insight: The status surface and agents catalog now expose identity eligibility, control-plane authority, exact candidate state, and next actions without credentials or personal identifiers.
items.evidence: status-proof 13/13 feeds · mobile browser contract green

items.title: Fresh evidence by default, strict CI always
items.insight: Local Lighthouse advice no longer presents artifacts older than 24 hours as current regressions. Dedicated check mode preserves every blocking threshold.
items.evidence: Lighthouse advisory self-test 23/23 · remote Lighthouse green

items.title: Sharp safe range made explicit
items.insight: The scripts workspace no longer depends on an untracked lockfile to avoid a vulnerable Sharp range. Its manifest uses the official trust-approved 0.35 line.

items.title: A deploy trigger that cannot skip itself
items.insight: Remote proof caught the empty closeout wakeup commit quoting a recognized CI skip directive in its own subject. The directive is gone, and the closeout boundary now rejects any recurrence before commit.
items.evidence: closeout-boundary positive + negative self-tests · live invariant green

followUps: Provide Supabase management/SQL/Function authority through the Studio secrets gateway, then deploy the archive migration and Eternal Intelligence update.
Compile a privacy-safe real-provider callback/session/member/investor/revocation trace and repeat the independent release gate.
Bind critical route/content hashes into a candidate artifact Merkle manifest.
blockers: Supabase authority is 1/4 ready: REST works, while management, SQL, and Function deployment credentials are unavailable.
Runtime SQL/Function state and a real-provider signed-in ceremony remain unverified, so production promotion stays held.

honestyLedger.title: No partial-authority promotion
honestyLedger.why: REST availability proves only REST; it cannot authorize DDL or Function deployment.

honestyLedger.title: No old-staging green
honestyLedger.why: Candidate readiness now requires the live staging beacon to equal the candidate SHA.

honestyLedger.title: No source-equals-runtime claim
honestyLedger.why: Undeployed SQL/Function changes and absent real-provider evidence remain explicit dark dependencies.

diffStat.suite: 218 build checks + 47 auth units + 29 compliance + 40 stress
